description: Subscribe to a centralized agent via the x402 rail. Requires access_token (registered-user JWT). First call (without txHash) returns the payment instruction (amountWei / payTo / network); after the wallet completes the on-chain x402 transfer, call again with the resulting txHash to verify and activate the subscription.

priceWei.description: Plan price in wei (overrides the default active plan price)

txHash.description: x402 on-chain payment tx hash — include to verify and activate

name: actora_central_subscription_subscribe
title: Subscribe Central Agent
